performance_case.causal_mechanism: Point-in-time active-buy pressure above the contemporaneous OKX book midline may contain information that persists beyond mechanical same-interval price impact into later 15- and 60-minute returns, but a single-venue signal may instead reflect cross-venue leader-lag reaction.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may assess only the external causal prior and the alignment of already frozen V3 gates. It cannot access outcomes, establish statistical significance, PnL, drawdown, fees, fills, capacity, candidate readiness, OOS value, or any Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: If later economic evidence shows that the frozen signal avoids adverse short-horizon paths rather than merely following contemporaneous impact, maximum drawdown may improve versus matched controls; this prior audit itself leaves drawdown MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A scope-correct prior can prevent spending the later 42-day economic cycle on a mechanism that only explains contemporaneous impact or another venue's price discovery, while an over-strict prior could wrongly discard a useful forward association that the frozen V3 screen can cheaply test.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Only if the frozen V3 next-minute 15/60-minute screen later passes and the separate 30-bps matched-capital route also passes may the mechanism improve fee-adjusted total PnL; literature support alone has zero immediate performance effect.
